picks.title: Traverse City Turkey Trot sets record turnout with nearly 3,000 participants
picks.desc: Nearly 3,000 participants set an all-time attendance record at the 19th annual Traverse City Turkey Trot this Thanksgiving morning. The event featured a 5-K and a five-mile race, which was won by Traverse City Central High School senior Evan Fox. TRAVERSE CITY- Nearly 3,000 runners and walkers turned out today in Traverse City for the 19th annual Turkey Trot, establishing an all-time attendance record for the Thanksgiving morning tradition. The event drew participants to downtown streets for both a five-mile race, known as the Five Mile Flyer and a 5-K run.

picks.title: Small Business Saturday highlights the impact of shopping local in Northern Michigan
picks.desc: TRAVERSE CITY - Where you spend your holiday shopping dollars can make a difference close to home. Small Business Saturday returns November 28, giving shoppers across Northern Michigan an opportunity to support independent retailers, restaurants and other small businesses while finding gifts for the holiday season. But the impact of shopping small goes beyond a single day of sales. Local businesses help support jobs, keep money circulating in their communities and contribute to the downtown districts that make Northern Michigan towns unique.
